dependencies.name: macOS
dependencies.purpose: Supported host for the local workflow and browser launch.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: The plugin setup and local launch are not supported on this host.

replacement.suggestion: Run the workflow from a supported Mac.
replacement.warning: No non-macOS runtime has been validated.

dependencies.name: git
dependencies.purpose: Fetches the exact Rhize Outreach runtime commit from its source repository.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: The pinned runtime cannot be installed or checked for source drift.

replacement.suggestion: Install Git and verify access to github.com.
replacement.warning: A local copy without the pinned origin is not accepted.

dependencies.name: node
dependencies.purpose: Node.js 24.12 or newer runs the pinned workflow runtime.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: The runtime cannot be installed or started.

replacement.warning: Older Node versions are not supported.

dependencies.name: npm
dependencies.purpose: Installs the pinned runtime dependencies with npm ci.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: The runtime dependencies cannot be installed reproducibly.

replacement.suggestion: Install the npm version bundled with supported Node.js.
replacement.warning: Do not use npm install to change the lockfile.

dependencies.name: PostgreSQL binaries
dependencies.purpose: initdb, pg_ctl, and createdb manage the private local workflow database.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: The local workflow service cannot start its isolated database.

replacement.suggestion: Install PostgreSQL command-line tools and select their bin directory.
replacement.warning: The app does not connect to Rhize Scan or another shared Supabase project.

dependencies.name: Codex CLI
dependencies.purpose: Runs the constrained local graph worker; the user must be signed in to ChatGPT.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: Agent stages cannot run; the local operator UI and saved data remain available.

replacement.suggestion: Install Codex CLI and authenticate with the intended ChatGPT account.

dependencies.name: rhize-outreach runtime
dependencies.purpose: The local-first operator UI and resumable selected-business workflow, fetched at an immutable commit.

wizard.purpose: Check local prerequisites, fetch the pinned runtime, and configure private local storage.

artifacts.purpose: Non-secret runtime revision, source/data/artifact paths, PostgreSQL bin directory, and local port.
Versioned checkout of the pinned Rhize Outreach runtime and its installed dependencies.
Private local PostgreSQL state and generated deliverables; kept outside the versioned runtime checkout.
